harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis {عَلِمَتْ} in verse (14); «الشمس»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of an implied verb explained by what follows it, and the clause «كُوِّرت» is explicative; and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «النجوم»: fāʿil (agent) of an implied verb explained by what follows it, and the clause «انكدرت» is explicative; and the clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis is conjoined to the initial one, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: (بأي ذنب قتلت) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قُتِلت», and the clause «قُتلت» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «علمت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «لا أقسم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «الجوار»: badal (substitute) of «الخُنَّس», genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; «الكُنَّس» is a naʿt (adjective) of «للجوار».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His saying «والليل»: a noun conjoined to «الخُنَّس»; «إذا»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أُقْسِمُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: (إنه لقول رسول كريم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «ذي»: naʿt (adjective) of {رَسُولٍ}; «عند»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مكين»; «مكين»: naʿt of {رَسُولٍ}.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «مطاع»: second naʿt (adjective); «ثم»: an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مطاع»; «أمين» is a third naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: (وما صاحبكم بمجنون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam) in verse (19), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and the clause «لقد رآه» is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ}; the lām is that of the oath; the preposition «بالأفق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رآه».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: (وما هو على الغيب بضنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {رَآهُ}, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The interrogative clause is resumptive, and «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «تذهبون».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: (إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; «إن» is negating and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكر».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «لمن» is a badal (substitute) of {لِلْعَالَمِينَ}; the preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «شاء»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: (وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله رب العالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ; «رب» is a badal (substitute).
